method.origin: Written guidance received from the Rehabilitation Measures Database team on 2026-09-04.
method.rule_1: Use the RMD instrument summary for measurement properties, Cost and Cost Description when the instrument is covered by RMD.
method.rule_2: Do not interpret RMD Cost=Free as Public Domain and do not interpret Not Free as copyright restriction without reading Cost Description.
method.rule_3: Use Mapi Research Trust/ePROVIDE or the named copyright holder/developer to determine copyright, permission, translations and administration conditions.
method.rule_4: Arabic psychometric validation, access to the exact Arabic form, and permission to reproduce the Arabic form are three separate gates.
method.rule_5: A Rawafid operational recording sheet may document a performance procedure without reproducing a protected fixed item set; the page must not imply ownership or endorsement.
method.rule_6: When sources conflict, retain the more restrictive publication decision until the exact version and holder terms are resolved.

decision_states.full-ok: Full executable/printable form may be provided with the documented rights basis.
decision_states.full-ok-with-attribution: Full form may be provided, but copyright/attribution or license wording must remain visible.
decision_states.operational-sheet-only: Rawafid may provide an original recording/procedure sheet but must not reproduce a protected instrument item set.
decision_states.official-link-only: Do not mirror or retype the instrument; link to the owner/distributor route.
decision_states.hold-exact-arabic: Rights are sufficient but the exact validated Arabic source form has not yet been verified; do not substitute a new translation.
decision_states.hold-rights: Rights/administration conditions require further verification before reproducing the form.
